events.title: 노츠 카운티 go second in the Second Division with a 1–0 win at 포트 베일, boosting their hopes of a second successive promotion.
Peter Taylor , former managerial partner of 브라이언 클러프 , dies suddenly of pulmonary fibrosis whilst on holiday in Costa De Los Pinos, Majorca, at the age of 62.

In the biggest Second Division win of the season, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 헐 시티 7–1 at Upton Park . 울버햄프턴 원더러스 boost their hopes of a third promotion in four seasons by beating 브리스틀 시티 4–0 at home, with Steve Bull scoring a hat-trick. In the First Division, 사우샘프턴 and 첼시 draw 3–3 in a thrilling match at The Dell . 리버풀 make it eight consecutive wins by beating 더비 카운티 2–0 at Anfield , while 아스널 keep the gap between themselves and the leaders at six points by beating 노리치 시티 2–0 at Highbury .

The pressure mounts on 에버턴 manager Colin Harvey after a 3–1 defeat at 노팅엄 포리스트 leaves his side third from bottom in the First Division after just one win and five points from their opening eight games.
Copa Libertadores 1990 is won by Olimpia Asunción after defeating 바르셀로나 Sporting Club on an aggregate score of 3–1.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 strengthen their promotion bid with a £600,000 move for 루턴 타운 defender Tim Breacker .

Croatia host their first match in the modern period after gaining independence from Yugoslavia, a friendly against United States in Zagreb . Croatia wins 2–1, and the first goal for the Croats in the modern era is scored by Aljoša Asanović .

21 of the 22 players on the pitch brawl in 아스널's 1–0 league win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford . In their ninth league game of the season, 리버풀 drop points for the first time when 노리치 시티 hold them to a 1–1 draw at Carrow Road . The gap between first and second place is cut to four points as a result. 토트넘 홋스퍼 keep up the pressure with a 4–0 home win over 셰필드 유나이티드, with Paul Walsh scoring a hat-trick. The bottom two clubs are still winless after nine games.
애스턴 빌라 beat Italian favourites 인테르 2–0 at Villa Park in the UEFA Cup second round first leg. In the Second Division, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's promotion hopes are hit by a 3–1 home defeat to struggling Charlton.

The Manchester derby at Maine Road ends in a 3–3 draw between City and United. 리버풀 return to their winning ways with a 2–0 home win over 첼시. 아스널 keep up the pressure with a 1–0 home win over 선덜랜드 at Highbury, as do 토트넘 홋스퍼 with a 2–1 win at 노팅엄 포리스트, and 크리스털 팰리스 with a thrilling 4–3 home win over 윔블던. The top four in the First Division are all unbeaten after 10 games, as are the Second Division's top two clubs Oldham and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 after 14 games, and Fourth Division leaders Torquay after 13 games.

에버턴 sack manager Colin Harvey after their worst start to a league season leaves them third from bottom in the First Division. Below them are 더비 카운티 and winless 셰필드 유나이티드, while 리버풀 remain top with nine wins from their opening 10 games. 아스널, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 크리스털 팰리스 are their nearest contenders, and the top four are all still undefeated in the league. The Second Division promotion race is heating up, with 올덤 애슬레틱 still top of the table and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 having crept up to second place. 셰필드 웬즈데이 occupy the third and final automatic promotion place. 밀월 , 울버햄프턴 원더러스 , 반즐리 and 미들즈브러 have all climbed into the playoff zone this month. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are in real danger of a second successive relegation as they occupy second from bottom place in the Second Division with eight defeats from their opening 13 games. The Football League Cup third round action includes a Mick Harford hat-trick for 더비 카운티 in a 6–0 home win over his old club 선덜랜드. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리버풀 3–1 at Old Trafford . 노팅엄 포리스트 keep their hopes of a third successive League Cup triumph alive with a 2–1 win at Plymouth .
